info.name: A New Revelation
info.parent: The Secret Behind Space Time Transformations

descriptions.notStarted: When I told Papulatus that I had come from the future, he seemed very interested in learning more about me. I guess he got even more excited when I told him that he, in the future, was doing some pretty major things... Little does he know that he's doing some pretty radical, negative things... Anyway, how am I supposed to get back to the future now?
descriptions.inProgress: Papulatus asks me to be his guinea-pig for the research he's been working on, which is almost complete. He says he'll send me back into the future where I came from... I don't like the idea that I'm a guinea-pig for his research, but I can't stay in the past like this forever. I guess I should trust Papulatus for now and get back to the future to tell Rolonay about what had happened.
descriptions.completed: I don't know if it's a remnant of the power I felt during my transition between dimensions but I've somehow acquired the power to control space and time. I'll call this skill 'Time Lift'.
